fields.label: Chat ID
fields.placeholder: Paired via /start or enter Chat ID
fields.helpText: Auto-filled when you pair via /start, or enter your numeric Chat ID

pairing.helpText: Generates a 10-minute /start command to link your private Telegram chat.

setupGuide: 1. Message @BotFather on Telegram (/newbot) to create a bot and copy its Bot Token.
2. Paste the Bot Token below and click Pair Account… to generate a 1-time /start command.
3. Send the /start command to your bot in Telegram — Chat ID fills in automatically.
